reasons.action: The request explicitly instructs continuing from the end of the clip and landing on the picture as the final frame, so the action is request-governed.
reasons.medium: No explicit reimagine/restyle or target rendering instruction is present; the medium decision preserves the observed live-action reference medium.
reasons.wardrobe: No wardrobe or accessory change is requested for either car; the observed carbon-fibre body attributes remain reference-defined. Wardrobe attributes are empty because a car body material is not a garment or accessory.
reasons.lighting: There is no explicit instruction about the light, its source, direction, or visible quality; continuation and the dock-road setting do not authorize replacing reference lighting.
reasons.framing: The 16:9 aspect and 8-second duration are canvas and timing configuration, not camera framing or composition instructions, so reference framing governs.
reasons.palette: No explicit palette instruction is given, so the reference palette is retained.
